title: Nutty Nourishing Turkish ground annatto Kazandibi
description: A pungent, crunchy one-pot Turkish dish featuring ground annatto, clay-pot-cooked to perfection. Perfect for Mediterranean diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the annatto seeds, Turkish red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the clay pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the clay pot, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the liquid has thickened.
Stir in the chopped parsley and crushed walnuts. Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
